title: Eaden East
description:
Cozy and quiet 1 BR condo in East Nashville (Inglewood) just minutes away from Downtown Broadway, and local bars and restaurants.  Features cozy king size bed, pullout sofa bed, smart TV's, and a fully stocked kitchen.  Secure entry for peace of mind. Minutes to downtown Nashville and Grand Ole Opry.

The space
Bedroom with King bed with attached bathroom (shower/tub) and laundry room.  pull out sofa in living room, linens provided. 

Fresh linens, towels, body wash, shampoo and conditioner provided.

Roku Smart TV's in bedroom and living area.  

Fully stocked kitchen with complimentary coffee.

Getting around: Uber & Lyft are easily accessible.  Free parking on-site.

Guest access
The entire unit is available.

Other things to note
Video surveillance in progress for safety and security purposes outside and hallway. 

No smoking inside unit; $200 cleaning fee will be accessed.  

No pets allowed, consideration for other guests who may be allergic. $200 cleaning fee will be accessed.

A $20 per hour fee for early check-in and/or late check out. 

No parties.

Booker must be over the age of 21 per Nashville code.

Bookings may be declined for accounts that have no previous Airbnb history.

Per fire code: 4 person maximum capacity 

Booking & Identification Policy:
Reservations must be made by the individual who will be staying at the property. Third-party bookings are not permitted. The name on the reservation must match the primary guest occupying the property. Unregistered guests and visitors are not permitted without prior approval. 

A valid government-issued photo ID may be requested prior to check-in or upon arrival to verify the identity of the registered guest.

We do not accept reservations from local guests. Reservations made by individuals residing within the local area may be declined or canceled.

Failure to comply with these requirements may result in cancellation of reservation.
